module: Development example of the editor's "headless" mode (hides menus and toolbars to show only its own tool). The module only exports its hooks if shipping_build is false: in a production build, it is empty. It shows how to enter/exit the mode (editor.enableHeadless), draw your own menu bar via onEditorHeadlessMainMenuBar and open a tool window and a floating toolbar.
usage:
-- enable headless mode for a tool
editor.enableHeadless(true, 'myHeadlessTool')
-- disable it
editor.enableHeadless(false, 'myHeadlessTool')
notes: No function is exported in a production build (shipping_build): the hooks are only defined outside shipping.
The tool name ("myHeadlessTool") must be unique; the functions only act if editor.isHeadlessToolActive(toolName) is true.
The menu is called "Headless Editor Test" (Debug group); the toolbar buttons only do prints.
